components.name: backrest
components.description: the tall back panel/frame rising vertically from the rear edge of the seat; a single upright rest for the sitter's back

components.name: seat
components.description: the horizontal seat pan the sitter sits on; a flat slab supported on the four legs, with the backrest rising from its rear edge

components.name: front-left leg
components.description: the front-left vertical leg running from the floor up to the front-left corner of the seat underside

components.name: front-right leg
components.description: the front-right vertical leg running from the floor up to the front-right corner of the seat underside (mirror of the front-left leg)

components.name: back-left leg
components.description: the back-left vertical leg running from the floor up to the back-left corner of the seat underside

components.name: back-right leg
components.description: the back-right vertical leg running from the floor up to the back-right corner of the seat underside

components.name: front stretcher
components.description: a horizontal connector bar spanning between the two FRONT legs near the bottom, bracing them together

components.name: back stretcher
components.description: a horizontal connector bar spanning between the two BACK legs (back-left to back-right) near the bottom, bracing them together

components.name: left stretcher
components.description: a horizontal connector bar spanning between the two LEFT legs near the bottom, bracing them together

components.name: right stretcher
components.description: a horizontal connector bar spanning between the two RIGHT legs (front-right to back-right) near the bottom, bracing them together (mirror of the left stretcher)
